opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: an external purchase link advertises a 52% discount and a multi-device account, search results promote extensions that bypass government, school, or company blocks, and the speaker escalates from fixing one browser error to claiming that nearly all internet and browser problems will be solved. Those signals make the VPN offer look like an easy technical shortcut whose broad promised result is difficult for viewers to verify.

That overbreadth is the relevant warning sign, even without an explicit income claim.
